name: Clock probe: a 45 s proc internal cooldown holds and then expires across long waits
contract: Val'anyr's equip aura 64415 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on Blessing of Ancient Kings 64411 with
ProcChance 100 in the installed Spell.dbc. Its effective spell_proc row (db_world 2026_02_18_01) has Chance 0,
so the DBC 100% applies, ProcFlags 279552, SpellTypeMask 2 (heal), SpellPhaseMask 2 (hit) and Cooldown 45000;
spell_item_valanyr_hammer_of_ancient_kings only requires a positive heal. Aura::PrepareProcToTrigger sets the
aura's proc cooldown to now + 45000 ms on the steady game clock, and an attempt during it neither procs nor
extends it. Flash Heal 2061 rank 1 is a 1500 ms direct heal; the priest's health is lowered before each heal.
The first heal procs once. A heal landing about 39.5 s after that proc is inside the internal cooldown and
leaves the count at 1; a heal landing about 47.5 s after it procs again. The 5.5 s and 2.5 s margins dwarf a
25 ms world step. The fixture aura exercises the proc clock of Unit::GetProcAurasTriggeredOnEvent;
clock-equip-proc-cooldown-long-wait covers the equip cooldown. A proc clock that runs more than 14% ahead of
game time lets the 39.5 s heal proc. A proc cooldown timed on the wall clock misses the 47.5 s proc when game
time runs more than 5.6% faster than the wall clock between the first proc and that heal, and lets the 39.5 s
heal proc when it runs more than 12.2% slower; between those rates the probe cannot tell the clocks apart, so
a negative control needs a run that fast-forwards, such as one lane running only this case.

steps.label: SETUP: the proc aura is present
SETUP: the first heal procs Blessing of Ancient Kings
SETUP: the proc applied Blessing of Ancient Kings
Long wait inside the 45 s internal cooldown
Heal landing about 39.5 s after the proc
DISCRIMINATING: a heal inside the internal cooldown does not proc
Wait past the end of the internal cooldown
Heal landing about 47.5 s after the proc
DISCRIMINATING: after the internal cooldown the next heal procs again
